bigm_validation_scope: AITER 9cdcf70d, max_num_batched_tokens=32768 with 8192 local tokens per tile, measured on an experiment tree whose tail used torch copies instead of copy_tail: one warmup and one formal A/B round (128K input + 100 output, C16), formal total throughput 52169.19 -> 62336.82 tok/s (+19.49%); GSM8K 3-shot 87.72 (native 87.49), 72-shot 93.78 (native 93.71). This tree: copy_tail covers FP8 scales of tiles over 4096 rows; the tile is min(ceil(max_num_batched_tokens / SP size), 8192) (MXFP8: 256 / SP size), so the 32768 budget on SP4 selects the same 8192-row tile without an environment variable; 74 SP MegaMoE tests including GPU copy/graph at 8192 rows passed. No full-model run on this exact tree yet.
